title: Verdict.eth
tagline: ENSv2 trust & verification registry for RWAs, enforced by autonomous AI agents.
description: Verdict is an institutional verification registry and multi-agent consensus layer built natively on ENSv2 for tokenized Real World Assets (RWAs). Currently, protocols and autonomous agents must blindly trust raw contract addresses and static issuer PDFs. Verdict replaces this with machine-readable, canonical ENS profiles (e.g., buidl.rwa.verdict.eth) backed by an autonomous 4-agent inspection fleet evaluating Legal compliance, Custody reserves, and Technical security. By enforcing cryptographic separation between issuers and auditors, Verdict enables DeFi protocols like Aave and Morpho, RWA issuers like Ondo, and autonomous treasury DAOs to automate collateral onboarding and risk gating directly on-chain with zero counterparty tampering.
how_its_made: Verdict is built natively on ENSv2 on Sepolia, leveraging Permissioned Resolvers and Enhanced Access Control (EAC) to achieve strict cryptographic separation of authority. While issuers manage their asset profiles, only authorized auditor keys receive scoped setter roles for attestation records, making it mathematically impossible for issuers to forge audit scores. The application is built with Next.js, React Flow for interactive agent orchestration, Framer Motion, and Viem/Wagmi for on-chain resolution. We implemented an autonomous 4-agent quartet (Legal, Custody, Technical, and Consensus Synthesizer) along with an on-chain Agent Factory that lets users connect their wallet to mint custom sovereign subnames and apply tailored risk lenses directly into the consensus verdict.
auto_summary: A Next.js app manages ENS-based RWA identity profiles, auditor permissions, and agent-generated verification verdicts on Sepolia.
